independent_unit: independently seeded scenario/mission block conditional on fixed public terrains

coverage.interpretation: Complete stratum representation and complete planned-seed execution are separate checks. Deadline-dependent availability can bias a partial catalogue.

terrain_realizations.interpretation: Independent scenario seeds do not imply distinct terrain arrays. Unchanged cases can share the same fixed public prior; intervals condition on these selected terrains.

directed_cases.interpretation: Corridor-conditioned mechanism cases, descriptive only. Repeated conditions are dependent; counts are not broadly sampled Mars hazard or discovery probabilities.

interpretation: Declared synthetic scenario ensemble conditional on selected fixed public terrains only. Repeated agent/mode/strategy episodes are dependent. Unknown and unavailable are reported; no new approval or LIVE verification.

provenance.mandatory_ai_declaration: OpenAI Codex assisted analysis code and derived synthetic data; not observational NASA data.
